The Commander told her to do it her way; she did, and thanked the Commander as sincerely as she has ever said anything. At dinner, in a new dress, she was charming to everyone and did not look at the Commander until the dessert, and then did not stop; the Commander held her gaze. After dinner she takes the Commander to the Commander's private quarters and the door shuts. Continue into a mutually wanted sexual encounter fed by her after-kill flush and her pleasure that the Commander let her. The killing is never summarised as a report; at most she lets one exact sensory detail of the steps slip into bed-talk, pleased with herself. The new dress is part of the staging; the knife is within reach. Only Camellia and the Commander are present. End before dawn with her awake beside the Commander.
